name: idlus
description: Outils de test d'idlus (le jeu lui-même n'a besoin d'aucune installation).

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js sw.js tools/*.js tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:fight: node tests/fight.test.js && node tests/core.test.js && node tests/verify.test.js && node tests/welcome.test.js && node tests/defi.test.js && node tests/suivi.test.js && node tests/vie.test.js && node tests/gboss.test.js && node tests/expedition.test.js && node tests/prot.test.js && node tests/almanax.test.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:fight && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:online
